# Tuteliq Unity SDK

> Official Unity SDK for Tuteliq, the child safety API for in-game chat moderation and player protection.

## What is this?
A Unity package for the Tuteliq child safety API. Moderate in-game chat, detect bullying, grooming and harmful content, screen nicknames, and run age and identity verification. Works with Unity 2021.3+ and .NET Standard 2.1.

## Install
Add via Unity Package Manager (Add package from git URL):
https://github.com/Tuteliq/unity.git

## Keep the API key off the client
The API key gives full access to the account. Call the SDK from a dedicated server or headless build, or point baseUrl at your own proxy that adds the key. Never ship the key in a game build.

## Quick Start
using Tuteliq;
var client = new TuteliqClient(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("TUTELIQ_API_KEY"));
var result = await client.AnalyzeAsync("content to check");
if (ModerationActions.ShouldWithhold(result.Action)) { /* do not deliver */ }
else if (ModerationActions.NeedsReview(result.Action)) { /* send to moderation queue */ }

## Moderation decisions
Route on RecommendedAction (or Action, the ModerationAction enum): none, monitor, flag_for_review, block, immediate_intervention, weakest to strongest. Not on risk scores or booleans. A bullying result with BullyingReported = true is a target or bystander reporting bullying: it still needs attention, routed to support.

## Key Features
- Text safety: bullying, grooming (with per-message sender age), unsafe content, quick analysis
- Fraud and extended detection: social engineering, app fraud, romance scams, mule recruitment, gambling harm, coercive control, vulnerability exploitation, radicalisation, distress signals, multi-endpoint analysis
- Nickname screening, verify-image-match, privacy redaction
- Media: voice, image, video and document analysis
- Age and identity verification sessions: CreateVerificationSessionAsync, GetVerificationSessionAsync, CancelVerificationSessionAsync (POST/GET/DELETE /api/v1/verify/session)
- Incidents: list, overview, trends, detail, review, batch review
- Webhooks, usage, pricing, GDPR account tools
- Automatic retries for rate limits (honours Retry-After), server and network errors

## Supported Languages
32 languages: English (stable), Spanish, Portuguese, Ukrainian, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, German, French, Dutch, Polish, Italian, Turkish, Romanian, Greek, Czech, Hungarian, Bulgarian, Croatian, Slovak, Lithuanian, Latvian, Estonian, Slovenian, Maltese, Irish, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Russian (beta). Auto-detected, no configuration needed.
